reference_sql:
WITH export_side AS (
  -- one row: purchase events on the Dublin days of December 2025
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS export_purchases
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
), first_payments AS (
  -- one row per subscription: when its first payment came in, refunded or not
  SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY subscription_id
), backend_side AS (
  -- one row: subscriptions whose first payment falls on a Dublin day of December 2025
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS backend_first_payments
  FROM first_payments
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
)
SELECT e.export_purchases, b.backend_first_payments,
  e.export_purchases - b.backend_first_payments AS difference
FROM export_side e
CROSS JOIN backend_side b
alternatives:
WITH export_side AS (
  -- one row: purchase events on the Dublin days of December 2025
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS export_purchases
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
), backend_side AS (
  -- one row: payments with no earlier payment of the same subscription, on a Dublin day of December 2025
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS backend_first_payments
  FROM payments p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM payments q
      WHERE q.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
        AND q.paid_at < p.paid_at)
    AND strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', p.paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
)
SELECT e.export_purchases, b.backend_first_payments, e.export_purchases - b.backend_first_payments AS difference
FROM export_side e
CROSS JOIN backend_side b

solver.query:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
), b AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at, arg_min(amount_eur, paid_at) AS first_amount FROM payments GROUP BY subscription_id) f
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
)
SELECT e.c AS export_purchases, b.c AS backend_first_payments, e.c - b.c AS difference
FROM e CROSS JOIN b
